subject: science
concept: Distinguishing a physical change (like cutting or melting) from a chemical change (like burning or rusting)
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Chemical Reactions) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes examples of physical changes (folding paper, melting ice) and chemical changes (rust forming, a cracker dissolving with fizz) and sorts them
exercise.pictorial: Student circles which pictured change is physical and which is chemical
exercise.abstract: Student explains the difference between a described physical and chemical change

misconception_flags: classifies a chemical change as physical because no new substance is visibly obvious

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
